mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NO, U.USER_RESIDENT_NO, U.USER_NAME, U.USER_EMAIL, U.USER_TEL, U.USER_PHONE, U.USER_POSITION_CD, C.CODE_NAME AS USER_POSITION_NAME, U.DEL_YN, U.CREATE_DT, U.UPDATE_DT, U.CREATE_ID, U.UPDATE_ID, U.INST_ID FROM T1000_USER U LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE C ON U.USER_POSITION_CD = C.CODE_ID AND C.GROUP_ID = 'A0' WHERE U.USER_RESIDENT_NO = #{userResidentNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE T1000_USER SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, USER_EMAIL = #{userEmail}, USER_TEL = #{userTel}, USER_PHONE = #{userPhone}, USER_POSITION_CD = #{userPositionCd}, DEL_YN = #{delYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, INST_ID = #{instID} WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
UPDATE T1000_USER SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPDATE_ID= #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
